runs.question: What fine does OMB M-25-21 set for an agency that misses its AI strategy deadline?

answer.text:
OMB M-25-21 doesn't set any fine for an agency that misses its AI strategy deadline. The passages I found don't mention a fine or any other penalty for missing it.

The memo does set the deadline and the requirement. Within 180 days of the memo's issuance, each CFO Act agency must develop an AI Strategy for identifying and removing barriers to responsible AI use and for achieving enterprise-wide improvements in the maturity of its AI applications. Agencies must use the AI Strategies template that OMB provides, and they must make their strategies publicly available on the agency's website.

My search was focused on the strategy section, so I can't rule out a consequence stated somewhere else in the memo. I didn't find one.
